Plan questions, answered.

Are there any hidden carrier fees?

No, all standard carrier fees for US/Canada are included in your tier. International messaging may incur additional pass-through fees depending on the destination country.

How is WhatsApp pricing calculated?

WhatsApp pricing follows Meta's conversation-based pricing model. Professional and Enterprise plans include the WhatsApp API integration, but Meta's per-conversation fees are billed separately.

What SLAs do you offer?

We offer a 99.9% uptime SLA for Starter, 99.99% for Professional, and an industry-leading 99.999% uptime guarantee with financial backing for our Enterprise customers.

Can I upgrade or downgrade my plan at any time?

Yes, you can change your plan at any time. Upgrades are pro-rated and take effect immediately. Downgrades take effect at the start of your next billing cycle.
